name: count the edge crossings of a ray from the point and read the parity
mechanism: shoot a ray from the point in any fixed direction and count how many polygon edges it crosses; an odd count means inside, even means outside; the winding-number variant sums signed crossings instead

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Point in polygon algorithms' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: tests whether a given point lies within a given polygon

fails_when: a ray through a vertex needs a tie rule
